Displayed effective annual cost includes the upfront fee and is a modelled cash-flow rate, not a statutory APR quote. This educational tool compares the entered terms.

HOW IT WORKS

Read. Check. Compare.

Use FundingFit

  1. Add 1–5 English offers in TXT or text-based PDF format. Analyse one offer, or add at least two supported offers to compare.
  2. Run AI analysis. Check the proposed numbers against the source text.
  3. Correct numbers and choose the actual currency and product conditions. Unsupported selections are clearly marked and left out until corrected.
  4. Gray offers cannot be calculated. They are excluded automatically; use Remove offer if you do not need them.
  5. Tick the verification box for each supported offer, then compare costs and cash limits.

Supported loans

EUR, USD or GBP; fixed nominal annual rates, equal monthly repayments, upfront fees paid separately and no other charges. Use matching loan amounts, durations and currency. No exchange-rate conversion is performed. Unknown fees stay blank. Variable rates, extra charges and incompatible repayment structures cannot be compared.

Your documents

Reading and calculations run locally in this browser. No offer text is sent to an AI service. The workspace clears when this page reloads. Exports are downloaded to your device.

The integrated AI

A trained character TF-IDF and logistic-regression model classifies loan clauses. Explicit parsers then propose values with source evidence. You check the terms before financial formulas calculate repayments and costs.

Model evaluation results will appear here.

Scores are not calibrated probabilities. Results on fictional development data do not establish accuracy on real bank contracts.

Course connection

The supplied ESG notebook covered text cleaning, dictionary counts and weighting. FundingFit adds supervised classification, source verification and an interactive financing comparison.

Project files

README.md is the user guide. AI_USE.md explains the methods, sources and AI assistance used to develop the project. The saved model, data, editable source and tests are supplied.
